balls.text: fullish ball outside off. Comes down the ground to whack it through the covers but he makes zero connection. Through to MS and they scurry across for one. Only two runs conceded in the 20th over as KKR finish on 137/9
good length ball angling away. Pace off, course, as expected. Nudged to the off side for one

the Fizz adds a second. Starc moves to the off side before Mustafizur delivers the ball. Picks this length ball well as he tries to pull a six, but despite his positive move, all he can do is find deep square leg. Purple cap now for Mustafizur
full ball, bit wider outside off stump. Comes down the track to try and generate some power. But can't connect with an off-side slap
Starc deceived, but he's lucky he is still not out. Fullish ball just outside off but the cutter zips in and goes past the edge to the keeper

A 100th catch for Jadeja in the IPL! Cutter, off a good length and angling away. Shreyas tries to clobber a six over the leg side, but the connection is poor. Jadeja is at deep midwicket, so Shreyas can begin starting to walk back even before the catch is completed.

good length ball just outside off. Anukul tries to thwack it over wide long on, but the change-of-pace forces an error. Ball goes high up but there's no mid-on present so Deshpande tries to run after it for a catch. Solid attempt but dropped
pace off again. Length ball around off. Shreyas tries to ping a pull to the leg side but he mistimes it again. In the air but lands safely at midwicket
back of a length delivery around off. Deshpande changes his pace and Shreyas looks to pull. But he's mistimed it, and he's very lucky the edge went over MS Dhoni
good length ball outside off. Punched uppishly through the point region for one

Deshpande adds a third! Fullish ball outside off, but with pace off. Russell tries to tonk it over long on, but it is mistimed. Mitchell at long on gets around and then takes the catch. Deshpande enjoyed that wicket, completes the celebration with a rodeo-style lasso loop
around the stumps to Dre. Bowls a yorker length ball but with a dash of width. Russell stays very deep in his crease before muscling a square drive for four
short and wide delivery. Left alone even though it doesn't bounce as much
full ball wider outside off. Shreyas drags a leg-side shot, adjusting for the change of pace, and hits it well, but will go to cow corner on the bounce
fullish ball wider outside off. Forcing Russell to play away from his arc. Puts all his body behind an attempted shot over cover, but it takes the edge and lobs over backward point

cutter delivery, length ball outside off and Russell moves a bit to the off side before cutting. But this ball has gone significantly beyond the tram-lines. No wide given but KKR review and have the decision overturned

He's human after all - dropped by Dhoni! A beautiful change of pace ball, landing just outside off and going further away. Russell is completely deceived as he tries to hit it over mid off, and the edge goes to Dhoni's right in slow-mo. He sticks his hand out but it doesn't stay
no run off the free-hit. Length ball just outside off. Slower ball again. Russell tries to hit it through the off side with the horizontal bat. Gets a bottom edge onto the ground and through to Dhoni
screeches across the carpet to beat the deep extra cover fielder. Full ball, slower one again, but this time not so wide as to stop Russell from reaching out and hammering a four. Front foot no ball!
beautiful from the Fizz. Full ball, even wider outside off and yet inside the tram-lines. Russell tries to slap it square but misses again. Slower one, of course
first ball, misses. Slower ball, full and quite wide outside off. Russell clears the front leg to try and hit the Fizz, but he misses the ball by a good metre or so
back of good length ball around off. Backs away and cuts to point. Keeps the strike for next over
short of good length ball on middle. Gently fends this first one. Another pace off delivery

stumps rattled! The slower ball works. Fullish ball, fifth-stump line, Rinku tries to muscle a shot over the off side but he's through the shot too early, and the ball finds the inside edge before coming back onto the poles
short ball around leg and he sees the ball bounce over his head. But the umpire says that's a legal ball!
length ball angling aross and he slaps a cut behind square. Rachin runs around from deep point to slide and stop the four
good length ball angling into his body. Clipped to deep square leg
length ball on middle and leg. Clipped to deep square leg for a single. Time out.
length ball around off. The cutter comes onto Iyer at a nice height, and he pummels a pull to the leg side. Couple of bounces before hitting the boundary, where Theekshana can't stop it
short ball on leg and he tries to club a pull over the leg side. But the ball ends up getting big on him, and there's a top edge to the vacant square leg region
short ball, pace off. Rinku drags it to deep midwicket for a couple, but still that's a win for the bowler in the 16th over
play and miss. Fullish ball just outside off. In Rinku's arc to hammer it away but he misses the slog. To the keeper. But Shardul has overstepped! Free hit coming up
good length ball just outside off. Ball shapes in slightly. Iyer tries to whack a shot through the leg side but mistimes it to square leg. Team 100 in 15.2 overs
full and wide ball, but inside the tram-lines. The slower ball too, and therefore it stays very low. Shreyas tries to club a boundary over cover but misses the connection
full ball around off and driven to long off. Theekshana finishes with 1-28
full ball on off. Too close to his body for the cut. Bunted to the off side
full ball on leg stump. Rinku presses forward to knock it leg side but he's deceived by the ball turning away. Falls over slightly as the ball turns past his bat to Dhoni
good length ball on off. Shreyas uses the depth of his crease before pulling to wide long on
good length ball outside off. Goes straight through to MS with Shreyas missing out on connecting with the cut.

short of good length ball on off. Goes deep in his crease before playing a pull over midwicket. Two outfielders on the boundary line get together, and Rachin is the one who dives to stop it, but we want to see if the recovery was clean

chance of a run out! But nothing in the end. Shreyas cuts Shardul to point, and Mitchell dived to stop the single. By then both batters were halfway down, and had the throw been closer to the stumps, one of them could've been gone.
length ball just outside off. Tries to hammer a shot through the leg side but deceived by the change of pace
short pitched ball outside off. Through to the keeper
good length ball on middle. Waits for it before playing a very late cut. Guided to deep third for a single
good length ball angling into off stump. Stands tall before hitting a punch to wide long on
good length ball just outside leg and nurdled off his waist to midwicket for one
short ball, pace off. Shreyas waits for it before swatting his Mumbai mate to deep square leg with a pull
full ball around leg. Rinku wants to end Jadeja's spell with a big shot, but he misses out on the slog sweep. Ball hits his pad, with impact outside leg stump. Jadeja finishes with 3/18
defends this fullish ball to the off side

taps this length ball to point and Shreyas wants one. Rinku does not, and he sends Shreyas back. Fielder Shaik Rasheed's throw to Dhoni is too strong, and with no one backing-up, KKR get an overthrow run
stumped by Dhoni? The crowd thinks so. But no, Shreyas' leg was back in. Fullish ball that whizzed past him to Dhoni
full ball on leg. Stays in his crease before clipping to cow corner
works this length ball off his waist to the leg side
good length ball around middle, and the first ball to Rinku is played quietly towards mid-on

Theekshana with a terrific response! Good length ball around off and the carrom ball zips through. Ramandeep makes some room to play a cut, but he's been deceived, and his middle stump has been rocked back. Ramandeep stands in disbelief before dragging himself out

clears wide long on, but just about! Theekshana with a half-tracker that doesn't bounce as much but Ramandeep goes deep in his crease before absolutely mauling a shot in front of square on the leg side. Hammered away
length ball on middle. Sliding into leg. Iyer punches with hard hands, with the ball in the air slightly before landing in front of mid on.
good length ball on middle but doesn't bounce as much. Swivels and tries to guide a pull along the ground but ends up mistiming it due to the lack of bounce. Towards backward square leg
full ball around off stump. Goes onto the back foot and taps it back to the bowler's right
first boundary in 34 balls! Fullish ball just outside off. Shreyas uses his hands to play a late cut, deflecting it fine past short third.
fullish ball angling down leg but Ramandeep moves further to the leg side before playing a shot to mid off's left
full ball around middle and driven to wide long off for a walking single
full ball on middle stump and he wants to play an on-drive but the ball goes to Jadeja's left instead
full ball darted into his pads. Closes his bat's face to play it leg-side but a leading edge sends it to cover point instead
length ball around off. Bit of turn away and he stands tall before punching a shot to long off
good length ball around off. Makes room before cutting it square. But a boundary-rider is manning that area
full ball outside off. Nice loop before landing near his toes. Driven to cover
full ball outside off. Gets low and sweeps against the turn to drag a shot to deep midwicket
full ball on off stump and he drives down the 'V' for a jogging single
full ball outside off. Late dip, and then turns away after pitching. Tapped to the off side
slow in the air, full on middle, and toe-ends a drive to the off side
length ball around off, and he makes some room to try and play a cut that could beat short third and point. They opt not to take a single
good length ball around off. Bit of turn away, and he pushes it to the off side
good length ball on middle, and punched back to Jadeja
full ball outside off. Ramandeep shows aggressive intent by attacking right away, lifting Jadeja over cover. But it will land inside the boundary line, and deep extra cover cuts it off

over the stumps to Venkatesh Iyer, and he has struck right away! A pure half-tracker angling into Iyer and he tries to pull. But Venkatesh has totally mistimed this freebie delivery, and he holes out at deep midwicket diving in the deep! Three wickets for Jadeja in eight deliveries!
around the stumps to Shreyas. Length ball on middle, and clipped off his pads to square leg
good length ball around off. Cut from close to his body, but gets it past Jadeja at short third. The fielder gives it a chase and drags the ball back from near the boundary line
terrific ball! Fullish ball on leg and Venkatesh is in two minds, whether to get forward and fend or stay back and block. Eventually pushes at it, but the ball whizzes past his outside edge to Dhoni
fullish ball on middle and skidding straight through. Iyer is hurried onto a leg-side flick, but ends up hitting the shot onto his pad
full ball outside off and sliding away. Gets low to play the sweep but misses. Through to MS
fullish ball on off and too close to his body for the cut. But he attempts it anyway, and ends up chopping the shot onto the pitch
good length ball on leg. Turning towards off. Soft-hand push to the leg side
length ball around leg and knocked off his waist to square leg for a single

Jadeja strikes again! Gets a length ball to drift and land outside off. Keeps it away from Narine's arc but doesn't stop the batter from attempting a shot anyway. Slices a flat-batted effort over the off side but long off gets in position early for a reverse-cup catch
full ball around off stump. Full face of the bat in his drive to long off
good length ball around leg. Swivels and hits it leg side to deep backward square leg
keeping the ball out of Narine's arc. Fullish ball, much wider outside off stump. Left alone
full ball just outside off. Driven along the ground to deep extra cover

out playing the reverse sweep! First wicket for a CSK spinner at Chepauk! Length ball on middle stump and going straight on. Raghuvanshi changes his stance to attempt a reverse sweep, but the wily Jadeja outsmarts the young Raghuvanshi. Hits his pads in front of middle stump, and KKR will not review this. Raghuvanshi was probably expecting a fuller ball there.
fullish ball around off. Clears the front leg to try and flat-bat a shot down the ground. Ends up smacking it right back to the bowler.
slower ball, full, but lands outside leg stump. Narine swings across the line to hit it, but misses
when you can get a dot off a short ball, then why not try it again eh? This short ball is closer to Narine's head, and he is forced to duck, unlike the previous ball.
short ball, fifth-stump line. Narine is happy to let that one go
cutter. Length ball on middle. Waits for it before hitting a punch towards deep extra cover
length ball on middle. Raghuvanshi skips down before playing a punchy shot to cover point
slower ball, full and wide. Reaches out but adjusts after spotting the lack of pace. Drives with the bat's open face, and manages to put away a boundary in front of point!

out? No, out-ta here! Full ball lands around off stump, and Narine eats these kind of balls for breakfast. Opens his stance a bit before clobbering Theekshana over long on. Hits the iconic brown tiles near the sightscreen. We need a new ball!
hits his pad but the ball pitched outside leg. Skiddy length ball that hurries onto the batter. He tries to flick it leg side but misses
half-tracker around leg stump and Narine works it off his waist to square leg for a quick single
full ball on leg. Gently clipped to the big pocket at wide long on, but they're happy to settle for just one
full ball on middle. Raghuvanshi commits to the big shot and then lofts it over the bowler's head for six! Connection not perfect, but still very good! Hits it through the ball's line.
good length ball outside off. Turning away slightly. Tentatively tapped to the off side
full ball on off and angling into middle. Defended to the leg side
solid comeback ball as Shardul lands a yorker just outside off. Narine backs away at first but then brings the bat down to keep the ball away
drilled! Full ball just outside off. Narine hammers a drive down the V, and Raghuvanshi gets out of the delivery's way. Beats mid off too, and once again Narine holds his shoulder
fullish ball angling into his pads. Guides a flick to square leg where there's a bit of a vacancy. Easy single
good length ball on a fourth-stump line. Checks a punchy shot, sending it towards point instead. Turns down the single

put away! Length ball angling into his hips, and Raghuvanshi doesn't need a second invitation. Smartly clipped to fine leg for a quick four! Uses his wrists to place it very fine. Very attractive shot
good length ball landing outside leg. Narine tries to pepper another aggressive shot to the leg side, but this time he can't get bat on ball. Thuds onto his pads

teases Mitchell before clearing deep square leg! Short of good length ball on leg stump. Narine raises the front leg before flicking beautifully off his waist, sending the ball upward into the leg side. Mitchell was prepping to put in a jump and catch on the boundary line, but the ball just evades him
short of good length ball outside leg. Skiddy one, going through to Dhoni down the leg side. Narine, for his part, tried to swivel and pull
clears mid off! Full ball just outside off. Narine clears the front leg and clubs an inside out four over mid off! Again groans and holds his left shoulder
change of line. This is a length ball on middle and angling away from Narine. Tries to reach out to drive but offers zero footwork. To Dhoni

squirts a four away, behind square leg! Mistimed, but in the powerplay that works. Deshpande tries to cramp Narine up by bowling a line that's outside leg. But Narine is committed to the shot, and even his mistimed effort goes for a boundary

grazes the thigh and goes behind for four. Length ball landing just outside leg stump, trying to cramp Narine. The batter tries to swing the bat to send it behind square leg but misses. Nonetheless gets four legbye runs
slower ball, 116kph. Full and wide, and Raghuvanshi's eyes lit up. But he loses his shape while trying to slog across the line. Through to MS again
past the edge to the keeper. Length ball angling across from the stumps and Raghuvanshi tried to play a late dab. He's lucky there's no glove to the keeper
full ball wider outside off. Raghuvanshi skips down the track and he uses his height and arm-reach to loft a drive over wide mid off
full ball on off. Compact defensive shot knocked away to the off side
good length ball around off. Narine hangs back before flat-batting to the leg side. But just one
taps this delivery to the off side for a single and brings Narine back on strike
fuller ball, wider too. Narine considers driving away from his body but doesn't throw all his power behind that shot. Past the edge to Dhoni
swing and miss. Length ball around leg stump and Narine clears the front leg before trying a leg-side swipe. He misses, and he's lucky his leg stump is still upright
good length ball on leg and he pulls, but to mid-on's left.
fullish ball just outside off. Fended compactly, and he squirts the ball between second slip and short third
two slips for him. Good length ball just outside off and gently tapped off the front foot to cover point

straight to point first ball! And Jadeja is not missing that. Perfect start for CSK. Deshpande with a wide ball outside off and he tried to drive, but plays it away from his body. The length wasn't right for the drive either, and CSK strike first ball.
width on offer and Gaikwad makes room to slap this through cover for four! Game, set and match as CSK make it 3/3 at home
tucks it gently into the square leg region for a single.  Scores level
shortish on the stumps, defended back
steered wide of point. The roar gets louder as Dhoni takes strike
driven straight to cover.

looks to finish it off in style but misses this full and straight delivery and sees the stumps flattened. May have been better off trying to hit it straight rather than attempting a heave. As Dube was out, there's a roar that engulfs Chepauk. And that's because  MS Dhoni is walking out to bat
he has muscled this somewhere into the train station behind the stadium! Arora bowls length on middle and leg, Dube is waiting for it and then pounces on it when it arrives. Incredible hit
another short ball on leg stump, through early with the pull this time as he's beaten
hustled for pace as Arora bowls a bumper, Dube is hit high on the bat as he tries to pull, lands short of the bowler on his followthrough
bunts this short of length delivery into the body to long-on
pushed to cover
struck on the pad by a fizzy delivery but this pitched miles outside leg. Shreyas Iyer opts for a review simply because they have one left.  Will stay as not out.
this is even bigger! Too much width, too full and right into his slot to swing freely. Clears wide long-off and sails way back into the second tier.
smashed down the ground into the sight screen! Uses his reach to access this length ball wide outside off and flat-bats it. So much power and muscle. Incredible
looks to slap this through cover, gets a thick bottom edge that rolls to short third.
cuts superbly but the boundary rider cuts it off at deep point
punched to deep cover
drills this full toss down to long-off
punched to long-on
driven down to long-off as they jog the single
mistimes the pull but the ball lands between deep midwicket and long-on. Got it high on the bat
works it to midwicket
that is outstanding from Gaikwad. Transfers weight back in a jiffy and helps this pull on its way to the deep square leg fence as Starc drops short.
slower length ball on middle and leg, defended back
in-swinging Yorker, gets it to tail late, squeezed to long-on
pummeled into the midwicket boundary! Bit of a drag down from Starc and Dube picks the length early as he blasts that away, one bounce to the boundary.
stands tall and punches this length ball to mid-off
welcomes Starc with a nice flick off his pads to deep midwicket.
works it down to long-on
punched down to long-on, Dube is away
tucks him up with a length ball on middle and leg, pushed to short midwicket
got him! Right through the gate. Mitchell advances to hit down the ground but the ball dips and spins in to beat the inside edge. Was in no position to play that shot.
squeezed to long-on as they jog the single
lunges forward and defends this fullish delivery
paddled round the corner to fine leg, excellent running again
driven hard to sweeper cover

lovely from Varun, enticed him into the drive, got the ball to dip and turn away. Gaikwad went for the drive and got the inside edge that flew past leg stump to fine leg. The two runs also brings up a lovely little half-century for Gaikwad
steps out to go down town but ends up yorking himself, squeezed off a thick inside edge past square leg
rocks back and pulls in front of square to deep midwicket
pushed to cover as Varun bowls into the pitch
flays that through point, sweeper cover glides across the turf to stop that
pulled imperiously into the gap at deep square! Slower ball into the pitch, Gaikwad swiveled, held his shape for a split second and then went hard.
slower and fuller on the stumps, Gaikwad turns this uppishly into the leg side, just short of midwicket
heaves this to wide long-on
slips one down leg, Mitchell misses an attempted tickle to fine leg
whips it past midwicket, called for two straightaway but won't get it
goes full on off, Gaikwad is well forward as he defends
squeezed to point as Varun bowls a full carromnball, they decide against the single
dabs it gently to short third for a single
tucked wide of midwicket, superb running from Mitchell to beat a slightly tardy Shreyas who tumbled away as he got to the ball.
the slowness of the delivery that time got to him. Gaikwad through with the pull even before the ball arrived, the ball rolled past short fine off the thigh pad.
gets across the stumps and nudges this into the gap at midwicket
pushed to long-off
punched to sweeper cover
tapped wide of cover as they squeeze another run
tucked wide of square leg
steps out and turns it down to the man coming in from long-on again
plants outside the line of the stumps to eliminate the lbw as he then bunts it into the leg side. Long-on has a lot of work to do in running in by which time they take the second
worked into the leg side as they take a quick single
gets well outside the line of the stumps to work it around the corner, gets hit on the pad.
nudged to square leg for a quick single
hit on the body as he swivels around to pull this shortish delivery.
makes room to punch through cover but the drift ensures the ball rolls back down the pitch off the inside edge.
pushed through quicker and fuller on middle again, Gaikwad stabs it into the off side
starts with a carromball on the stumps, Gaikwad lunges forward and defends
brings out the reverse sweep and he's hit that delightfully along the ground to bisect point and short third.
steps out and goes down town and picks the bones out of this. Lovely, lovely hit. Ensured he got to the pitch and swung through cleanly.
once again gets across the stumps and paddles it around the corner to fine leg
drop and run into the off side, neatly done as they beat Venky Iyer coming in from point
punches this wide of cover, looks for a single but sent back
premeditates the paddle, gets some bat on it as this rolls to short fine for a single
right behind the line of this as he defends back
too much width outside off and Gaikwad slaps that over point. CSK raise their fifty inside the power play. Poor from Aurora, this one sat up nicely for him to pick away.
my word! This is stunning from Gaikwad.  Packs a punch when he opens the face to pick the gap behind point. Used the pace and width to glide that to the fence

dropped by Ramandeep Singh at deep square! Mitchell whips this off his hip as he gets inside the ball, Ramandeep picked it early and came haring in from the ropes but was on the move when the ball lodged into his mitts and then slipped out. Costly miss.
on the pads again, tucked to long leg for a single
short of a length on middle and leg, tucked to deep square leg
cuts hard but cuts straight to Russell at backward point

that's the best of the lot! Makes room and drives gracefully through the covers on the up. Starc ran around it from wide long-off in the hope of trying to cut that off but he couldn't because the ball just purred away.
masterful from Rutu! Backs away and opens the bat face to scythe this cut between short third and backward point. Used the pace delightfully.

appeal for lbw as the ball skids back in from around the stumps, Gaikwad may have got a bit of an inside edge on it. Certainly looked bat first. KKR camp converges and Shreyas Iyer eventually signals for a review. Yes, replays confirm there was a big inside edge.  Not out it is.
bit of a mix-up as Gaikwad taps it into the leg side looking for a single, they don't take it in the end
glorious from Gaikwad! Makes room to free his arms and punches through the line through extra cover. Sumptuous
beaten by the slower length ball outside off, looked to upper cut but missed it in the end.
slips in a full ball down leg, flicked to Starc who stops it at short fine leg.
dabbed down to third man for a single
gently dabs it into the off side as he scampers a quick single

he has picked out long-on! Wonder if Rachin forgot the field had been pushed back. This was short of length and outside off, he swung through the line but instinctively let out a groan as he saw the fielder near the ropes.
tucked wide of short fine leg for a single
slips in a high full toss on leg stump and Rachin helps it on its way past short fine leg. Think Starc attempted a slower ball, but the ball may have slipped out possibly because of dew.
lovely roll of the wrists as he flicks this to deep square leg, Andre Russell comes around quickly to prevent the second
flicks it nicely down to deep square leg
clobbered down the ground once again! Sees this in his half and he lofts clearly through the line to beat mid-on. Lovely timing.
hammered! Touch fuller on middle and Rachin used his bottom hand to belt that down the ground, just wide of mid-on.
full and straight on the stumps, Rachin is leg side of the ball as he drives to mid-off
floats it full but ends up bowling it too far wide down leg, through to the keeper as Rachin flicks the humid air

bowls a second bouncer in the over, this one's ill-directed as he bowls outside off, Gaikwad makes a late decision to ramp that up and over, and he executes it very well. One bounce to the third man boundary. Simply helped it along.
excellent bumper! Gaikwad surprised by the bounce on middle, he was shaping to pull but let it go in the end
gets a solid forward stride in as he defends this length ball into the off side.
beaten by the low bounce as he tries to punch it into the point region
dabs this past the cordon to square third man as they jog the single
short of length on the stumps, Rachin rises with the bounce as he taps it into the gully region for a quick single
slants one across on a length, Gaikwad lets it pass.
has to rebowl that as he slips this full swinging delivery down leg, through to Salt
touch fuller on middle-and-off, Gaikwad is half-forward as he gently defends into the off side. Nice, tight line from Starc
bowls full, this one tails in late into middle, Gaikwad jams this full toss into the covers.
nips back in off a length on middle, Gaikwad solidly defends back as he covers the line nicely
length ball angling back into middle and leg, Gaikwad tucks it neatly off his hip past square leg
they'll sneak a leg bye as Rachin hops back to defend, the ball rolls a few yards away off the pad and they get across quickly
